track_A_public_velocity.window_rule: four predetermined windows distributed through the 71 indexed frames; do not call them systole/diastole without waveform alignment
track_A_public_velocity.physical_times: derive from verified release time interval; record frame-index origin explicitly
operators: physical full-box average with the same integral in each fitting loss
track_A_public_velocity.point_vs_average_location_control: point and averaged conditions use exactly the same certified full-box centres, split and noise realization
track_A_public_velocity.partial_volume: exclude crossing boxes; report lost coverage and wall distances; this is not a complete MRI acquisition simulation
track_A_public_velocity.primary_endpoint: pooled two-frame vector relative L2 on all fixed unobserved fluid-mask vertices in each window, then average across draws/windows within each geometry; sampled short adapter runs are excluded from final evaluation
secondary_endpoints: velocity errors by fixed mask-distance bins (image-grid proxy, not native wall distance)
model finite-difference divergence and common-HR-grid divergence/reference error
track_A_public_velocity.pressure_and_WSS: This velocity-array release supplies no independent pressure/WSS truth. This track cannot validate the complete original pressure/WSS pipeline.
track_A_public_velocity.statistical_unit: geometry (two held-out units); frames/windows/draws are dependent; no population significance claim
track_A_public_velocity.missing_boundary_data_rule: If the release does not supply trustworthy numeric inlet conditions or geometry-only wall/cap identification cannot be established on aorta01, predeclare an identical measurements-only velocity contract for all methods, omitting unsupported boundary targets. Label it a restricted-information external velocity robustness test; it does not validate the complete original pressure/WSS pipeline. Retain unusable-geometry and method failures.
track_A_public_velocity.array_index_convention: zero-based HDF5 row indices for the four predetermined windows; aorta01 timeframe metadata labels these rows 1..71. Physical time is 0.01*timeframe seconds after omission of the initialized zero frame. Validate this metadata contract before opening evaluation velocities.

metadata_verified: boundary_cond=0 is a label, not a numeric boundary waveform

track_A_public_velocity.spatial_coordinate_gate: Use the publication-derived 0.594 mm isotropic spacing as an explicit assumed grid definition; HDF5 contains no spacing/affine. The identity stored-component-to-grid mapping was calibrated on aorta01 and is frozen for evaluation; do not reselect it from held-out velocities. Report that anatomical origin/orientation are not independently established.

mask_proxy.source: upstream 4DFlowNet documented mask_threshold default; this is an image-grid convention, not a native CFD wall
mask_proxy.fluid_cells: all eight interpolation-cell vertices must exceed the threshold
mask_proxy.observation_centres: continuous Cartesian grid inside wholly fluid interpolation cells; no snapping to HR vertices
mask_proxy.full_box_certificate: all interpolation cells intersecting the complete box plus 0.1 mm margin must be wholly fluid; check interior holes as well as the outer box

track_A_public_velocity.selected_boundary_contract: measurements-only external velocity robustness: no numeric inlet profile, no no-slip targets, no outlet pressure/gauge targets for ANY method; shared geometry mask supplies sampling/collocation support only. The boundary_cond integer is not a usable waveform.

canonical_axis_calibration.development_source: aorta01 only, 50000 geometry-only interior points, eight predetermined frames
canonical_axis_calibration.global_sign: first mapped sign positive; anatomical orientation not independently established

track_A_public_velocity.boundary_and_flux_endpoints: No boundary residual or cap-flux endpoint is claimed under the measurements-only contract; numeric boundary targets and validated cap identities are unavailable.
track_A_public_velocity.execution_contract_status: specified before evaluation-target access; not a claim that development gates passed or evaluation ran; any change requires a fresh version and source/settings seal

track_B_new_native_CFD.purpose: independent pressure and WSS evaluation of the complete frozen pipeline
track_B_new_native_CFD.selection_rule: specify geometry, loading and export recipe without examining reconstruction outcomes; retain every eligible attempted case

wall traction/WSS vectors and named surface selection

track_B_new_native_CFD.boundary_contract: same prescribed inlet velocities, no-slip wall geometry and outlet gauge information for every method
track_B_new_native_CFD.primary_pressure: unsteady momentum integration with CFD eddy viscosity, explicitly labelled oracle closure
track_B_new_native_CFD.geometry_invariant_gauge: zero mean on the declared outlet-adjacent integration patch, identified by cap geometry/node IDs rather than the historical x > 0.130 m threshold
metrics: pressure relative L2 and RMSE Pa after common gauge
WSS magnitude/vector relative L2 and RMSE Pa
track_B_new_native_CFD.regions: freeze geometry-defined sac/body/neck and pressure regions before hidden targets are accessed
track_B_new_native_CFD.weighting: node-weighted primary metrics for continuity with the original study; area/volume-weighted sensitivities if original weights are available
track_B_new_native_CFD.analysis_unit: geometry; retain phase and draw dependence and report every adverse case

shared_method_contract.boundary_information: all available native wall nodes for the supplied CFD family, plus prescribed inlet data; apply an identical available-information contract to every method. Subsampling native wall constraints is a labelled sensitivity, not the primary comparison.
shared_method_contract.holdout: exactly 10 percent of the base observation locations, shared at both times and across methods; carry that split through location subsets; match both fitting and validation counts for removal controls
shared_method_contract.final_fit_policy: retain that hold-out for every method; no method receives an all-observation refit
shared_method_contract.hyperparameter_selection: observed velocity hold-out only; never hidden velocity, pressure, WSS, flux truth or test-case outcomes
shared_method_contract.neural_checkpoint: fixed terminal step; exploratory shorter feasibility fits cannot be presented as final rankings
shared_method_contract.RBF_capacity: Current direct solver and compact_capacity.py must be verified on Brosnan. For each native Case 1/9 and phase, both scalar/DF families under noisy point/volume operators require two increasing basis sizes passing numerical and known wall/inlet gates; both validation error and paired holdout predictions must change by <=2%. Verify saved model/prediction hashes and freeze common selected basis/settings before final scored runs. A single boundary pass cannot seal capacity.
shared_method_contract.RBF_selection: same predeclared support/ridge grid and known-boundary admissibility rule for scalar and solenoidal methods; select admissible converged fits by the shared observation hold-out, retaining all failures
shared_method_contract.failure_rule: report nonconvergence, nonfinite predictions, unsupported geometry and resource failures as outcomes; no silent case/method deletion
shared_method_contract.clean_truth: read-only arrays kept separate from observations; hash equality checked after every fit
shared_method_contract.removal_control: remove all locations within 1.25 mm; compare with random removal matched exactly in BOTH training and validation strata; retain the original scoring set
shared_method_contract.scope: synthetic kinematic robustness and reconstruction; no clinical validation or rupture prediction
shared_method_contract.numerical_solver_gate: record pressure integration stop codes, tolerance, iteration count and residual; absent or unresolved convergence cannot pass the final numerical audit
shared_method_contract.boundary_gate: check both known no-slip wall residuals and prescribed inlet residuals; record whether a wall-check pool overlaps fitting nodes; this is numerical BC verification, not independent biomedical validation
shared_method_contract.external_fit_implementation: Explicit measurements_only mode for all four fitting arms. Reject any simultaneous supplied boundary targets. Preserve the shared observation hold-out and operator-aware loss; external boundary residual/cap-flux endpoints are unavailable under this contract.
shared_method_contract.direct_solver_contract: Column-blocked float64 sparse Gram avoids full dense A. Explicit memory limits and CPU/CUDA factor device are recorded. Accept only original sparse-objective stationarity within the declared tolerance; factorization success alone is insufficient. Preserve failures; no dense disk spill to the NAS. Solver implementation and resource settings are part of the source/execution seal.

release_receipt: raw or processed input hashes and provenance
